key:
TUN mode starts the sing-box core as root only from a root-owned copy, and the copy's location failed the ownership check:
%s
If the command below reports the same problem, fix the ownership of that path.
en:
TUN mode starts the sing-box core as root only from a root-owned copy, and the copy's location failed the ownership check:
%s
If the command below reports the same problem, fix the ownership of that path.

key: The daemon service is installed on this Mac, so the command is its Install or update command: it refreshes the same copy and restarts the service.
en: The daemon service is installed on this Mac, so the command is its Install or update command: it refreshes the same copy and restarts the service.

key: Run this command in Terminal (it asks for your sudo password), then click Retry:
en: Run this command in Terminal (it asks for your sudo password), then click Retry:

key: 1. Forget the pairing on the launcher side:
en: 1. Forget the pairing on the launcher side:

key: 2. Remove the service (run in Terminal, your sudo):
en: 2. Remove the service (run in Terminal, your sudo):

key: Also wipe all daemon data — keys, clients, last-good (--purge)
en: Also wipe all daemon data — keys, clients, last-good (--purge)

key: The core runs inside a system daemon (sing-box lxd).
en: The core runs inside a system daemon (sing-box lxd).

key: The daemon answers; the core is running. Click for connection settings.
en: The daemon answers; the core is running. Click for connection settings.

key: The daemon is paired and answers; the core is stopped. Press Start to bring the VPN up.
en: The daemon is paired and answers; the core is stopped. Press Start to bring the VPN up.

key: The daemon stopped answering — reconnecting. Click for connection settings.
en: The daemon stopped answering — reconnecting. Click for connection settings.

key: The core inside the daemon failed: %s. Click for connection settings.
en: The core inside the daemon failed: %s. Click for connection settings.

key: The daemon is not answering. Check that the service is running (⚙).
en: The daemon is not answering. Check that the service is running (⚙).

key: The core is stopped — press Start to load the node list.
en: The core is stopped — press Start to load the node list.

key: The machine is not answering. Check that it is powered on and reachable on the network, then press Connect again.
en: The machine is not answering. Check that it is powered on and reachable on the network, then press Connect again.

key: The Bearer secret is only needed for a daemon running WITHOUT TLS (plain mode): there it is the whole authentication, paste it and press Enter. A paired mTLS daemon ignores it — the client certificate is the credential. The daemon owns the secret (daemon.json in its state dir); view it with the command below.
en: The Bearer secret is only needed for a daemon running WITHOUT TLS (plain mode): there it is the whole authentication, paste it and press Enter. A paired mTLS daemon ignores it — the client certificate is the credential. The daemon owns the secret (daemon.json in its state dir); view it with the command below.

key: On Save the config is written to bin/remote-config.json for deployment under the lxd daemon — the local bin/config.json is never touched. State lives in bin/wizard_states/remote/state.json.
en: On Save the config is written to bin/remote-config.json for deployment under the lxd daemon — the local bin/config.json is never touched. State lives in bin/wizard_states/remote/state.json.

key: Set the TUN interface name explicitly — the core default cannot be relied on, and on a router the name is needed for firewall rules and routes.
en: Set the TUN interface name explicitly — the core default cannot be relied on, and on a router the name is needed for firewall rules and routes.

key: The config for the remote machine was written to a separate file. The local bin/config.json was not touched.
en: The config for the remote machine was written to a separate file. The local bin/config.json was not touched.

key: Failed to build the machine's config
en: Failed to build the machine's config

key: The core rejected this config. The file was written, but the machine will refuse it on Deploy. Fix the problem below and save again.
en: The core rejected this config. The file was written, but the machine will refuse it on Deploy. Fix the problem below and save again.

key: Could not read the subscriptions for this target, so the config would contain no proxy nodes. Check the sources on the Sources tab and try again.
en: Could not read the subscriptions for this target, so the config would contain no proxy nodes. Check the sources on the Sources tab and try again.

key: Connect to this machine first: its config points at the machine's own resource store, and that path comes from the daemon when you connect.
en: Connect to this machine first: its config points at the machine's own resource store, and that path comes from the daemon when you connect.

key: Stop the core on %s? Everyone routing through that machine loses VPN until it is started again.
en: Stop the core on %s? Everyone routing through that machine loses VPN until it is started again.

key: Restart the core on %s? Everyone routing through that machine loses VPN for a moment; if the start fails, the machine is left without a core.
en: Restart the core on %s? Everyone routing through that machine loses VPN for a moment; if the start fails, the machine is left without a core.

key: The machine runs a different config than the one saved here. Press Deploy to send it.
en: The machine runs a different config than the one saved here. Press Deploy to send it.

key: The machine runs the config saved here.
en: The machine runs the config saved here.

key: The last deploy did not start: the core rolled back to the last-good config. Details under ⓘ.
en: The last deploy did not start: the core rolled back to the last-good config. Details under ⓘ.

key: Send the config to %s (%d bytes)? The daemon validates it before swapping the instance and rolls back to last-good if the new one fails to start.
en: Send the config to %s (%d bytes)? The daemon validates it before swapping the instance and rolls back to last-good if the new one fails to start.

en: Connection settings: core engine and daemon pairing

en: No resources: nothing stored on the machine and no rule-set files in this machine's profile.

en: Could not read the resource store: %v

en: The running config references this file — deploy a config without it first

en: Delete %s from the machine? The local copy stays.

en: Connect to the machine first: the profiler reads its live connection stream.

en: Connect to the machine first: host telemetry is read over its control channel.

en: Read-only filesystems are excluded from the maximum: a squashfs root sits at a permanent 100%.

en: Graph the counter, read the rate: a counter survives restarts and gaps, a rate lies across them.
